Frequency once per round

Cost 2 Vitae

Both hands come up together. You stopped needing to look years ago.

Throw two prepared Grafts as part of the same activity, at the same target or different ones. Your multiple attack penalty applies to the second throw as normal. Only the first of the two applies its splash.
